enum Expr:
    literal(value: int64)
    add(left: Expr, right: Expr)
    divide(numerator: Expr, denominator: Expr)
    negate(inner: Expr)

enum EvalResult:
    value(number: int64)
    division_by_zero

function add_results(left: EvalResult, right: EvalResult) returns EvalResult:
    match left:
        value(left_number):
            match right:
                value(right_number):
                    return EvalResult.value(left_number + right_number)
                division_by_zero:
                    return EvalResult.division_by_zero
        division_by_zero:
            return EvalResult.division_by_zero

function divide_results(numerator: EvalResult, denominator: EvalResult) returns EvalResult:
    match numerator:
        value(numerator_number):
            match denominator:
                value(denominator_number):
                    if denominator_number == 0:
                        return EvalResult.division_by_zero
                    return EvalResult.value(numerator_number / denominator_number)
                division_by_zero:
                    return EvalResult.division_by_zero
        division_by_zero:
            return EvalResult.division_by_zero

function evaluate(expression: Expr) returns EvalResult:
    match expression:
        literal(value):
            return EvalResult.value(value)
        add(left, right):
            EvalResult left_result = evaluate(left)
            EvalResult right_result = evaluate(right)
            return add_results(left_result, right_result)
        divide(numerator, denominator):
            EvalResult numerator_result = evaluate(numerator)
            EvalResult denominator_result = evaluate(denominator)
            return divide_results(numerator_result, denominator_result)
        negate(inner):
            EvalResult inner_result = evaluate(inner)
            match inner_result:
                value(number):
                    return EvalResult.value(-number)
                division_by_zero:
                    return EvalResult.division_by_zero

namespace benchmark

function signed_gcd(a: int64, b: int64) returns int64:
    mutable int64 x = a
    mutable int64 y = b

    if x < 0:
        x = 0 - x
    if y < 0:
        y = 0 - y

    while y != 0:
        mutable int64 remainder = x modulo y
        x = y
        y = remainder

    return x

namespace benchmark

struct Interval:
    start: int64
    end: int64

function merge_sorted_intervals(intervals: list[Interval]) returns list[Interval]:
    mutable list[Interval] merged = list.new[Interval]()
    mutable bool has_current = false
    mutable int64 current_start = 0
    mutable int64 current_end = 0

    for interval in intervals:
        if not has_current:
            current_start = interval.start
            current_end = interval.end
            has_current = true
        else if interval.start <= current_end:
            if interval.end > current_end:
                current_end = interval.end
        else:
            merged = list.append[Interval](
                merged,
                Interval(start: current_start, end: current_end)
            )
            current_start = interval.start
            current_end = interval.end

    if has_current:
        merged = list.append[Interval](
            merged,
            Interval(start: current_start, end: current_end)
        )

    return merged
